description: Out-of-tree explicit spec (Axiom-owned) for the output-sizing bound C_out over stew/base36.nim decodedLength vs decode outlen. The subject tree (nim-stew @ 1853f20bdfeda61331a0b7e02f7aace0e88a0dfe clone) is READ-ONLY; this file is the only legitimate place the claim may live. Loaded via explicitSpecFromOverlay, which pins origin to soExplicit and fails closed otherwise. The obligation is rendered OPEN over L with a literal domain pin (3 <= L and L <= 3) so the SAT model binds L=3 and the exact-input gate can fire; a closed arithmetic proposition would starve the model-binding and P4 pre-revalidation.

claimConstant.meaning: decoded output length of s='kzz' observed by an external read-only probe (decode Success, outlen=2)
claimConstant.provenance: EXTERNAL_OBSERVATION — pinned as a claim constant by the contract's K-pin condition; NOT a pipeline-produced fact (see contract §3)

theorem.statement: forall L : Int, 3 <= L and L <= 3 -> decodedLength(L) >= 2 (instance obligation, open over L; the universal C_out is refuted by the five-link evidence chain in the contract §2)
theorem.character: single-instance refutation obligation of the universal Axiom-owned contract C_out; the instance is a counterexample witness, not the claim itself

semanticCaveats: Nim int is pointer-width signed; K=2 and L=3 are width-independent, but decodedLength(L) = (L*179) div 277 can OverflowDefect for L > high(int) div 179 — out of domain.
Nim div truncates toward zero; for positive operands truncation coincides with floor. 3*179 = 537 = 277*1 + 260, so decodedLength(3) = 1 unambiguously.
rvAgree means propertyHolds == false on the observed carrier result; it does NOT validate the K observation (decode semantics) — see contract §3 non-claim.
nonClaims: NOT a memory-safety claim (decode fail-closes pre-write)
NOT a claim that upstream promised an upper bound (docstring says 'estimated')
NOT a claim that the pipeline verified decode's semantics (K is an external observation)
NOT a claim that all inputs at every length violate (exists-type sweep only)
NOT a claim that nim-stew was modified or annotated in-tree (Zero-Footprint)
